forms.label: Standard
forms.animalOriginNote: Many red wines are fined with isinglass, gelatine or egg white or casein; unfiltered or vegan-labelled bottles are not. The finished wine contains at most a trace of the fining agent, but the label is the only way to know which was used for a given bottle.
forms.sourceNote: Alcoholic beverage, wine, table, red. Public domain. A generic dry table red is the right basis for a drink that names 'red wine' rather than a single varietal or producer. acidPercent left off: USDA reports no titratable acidity figure for wine and no other source was found here, though red wine's acidity is real.
